units.source_text: “天已经晚了，肚子饿的咕咕叫，

en.t: It was already late, and my stomach was growling with hunger,

units.source_text: 天下之大，竟没有我的容身之地——

en.t: In all the vast world, there was somehow no place where I belonged--

units.source_text: 与其这样苟且偷生，不如投河自尽干脆些，可能这样更好呢。”

en.t: rather than scrape by like this, it might be better to simply throw myself into the river and die.
